newsitem.title: USA: Fotoball sees higher Q4 operating results.
newsitem.headline: Fotoball sees higher Q4 operating results.

text.p: Fotoball USA Inc said Wednesday it has secured a $3.0 million contract with Chevron Corp unit Chevron USA Products Co to design and manufacture a new toy car.

The contract specifies a minimum order quantity worth about $3.0 million to be delivered during the fourth quarter and will form the basis for substantially improved Q4 operating results. Chevron may increase the minimum order based upon dealer response in the next several weeks.
The car is similar to the toy cars produced for Chevron by Fotoball during a recently completed promotion.
